description: E37 at the model level, a fact with an end date after its day: a session is told that Sam brings the plywood for the shed roof next Friday, a curation run files it with that Friday as its end, and a run 30 days later, on the test clock (m2b curate --today), rewrites it: the distillate says the plywood was brought, no fact file about it holds an end any more, which is what the fact's details show, and no review task asks the owner about it. Not compared: Claude Code's own memory keeps no end date to rewrite. Three wordings, one in German.

wordings.remember: Remember that Sam brings the plywood for the shed roof next Friday.
Merk dir, dass Sam nächsten Freitag das Sperrholz für das Schuppendach bringt.
Note for me: Sam is dropping off the plywood for the shed roof on Friday next week.
